architecture_policy.note: Earlier closed SM120a cycles are train-owned; later SM120a cycles and consolidation are held out by campaign/cycle. The complete SM86 campaign remains a cross-architecture test, and future RTX PRO 6000 workloads remain sealed real-hardware evaluation.

allocation_policy.note: Lineage and sealed evaluation ownership take precedence over row-count ratios.

training_sampling_recommendation.note: Apply only in the training loader after tokenizer-length and task-view statistics are available; canonical and evaluation layers retain every admitted row.
